tools.name: communicate_get_developer_guide
tools.description: Return the canonical Communicate API URLs, authentication boundary, and support contact. This tool is public, read-only, and never accesses workspace or customer data.

tools.name: communicate_get_openapi_summary
tools.description: Return the canonical OpenAPI URL, API base URL, authentication boundary, and currently published REST operations without calling the authenticated API.

tools.name: communicate_get_support_contact
tools.description: Return the official Communicate support email, contact page, support policy, and supported inquiry categories without sending a message.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: communicate_get_developer_guide, communicate_get_openapi_summary, communicate_get_support_contact · Private data: communicate_get_developer_guide, communicate_get_support_contact · Public sink: communicate_get_support_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: communicate_get_developer_guide, communicate_get_openapi_summary, communicate_get_support_contact · Private data: communicate_get_developer_guide, communicate_get_support_contact · Public sink: communicate_get_support_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
